state.context: Can P9 uses catalogue-only immutable html node/safe/url/attribute/tag and htmx target/swap values. No raw HTML, style, script or event attribute is authorable. Bun.escapeHTML must perform all text/attribute escaping; URL must do URL parsing. Child constraints require descendant detection for nested anchors/forms and head/body separation. URLs remember whether a single-slash local path was authored; HTMX requires that local kind. The native runtime is private; source programs cannot import it. Forged proxy/getter inputs must fail without invoking traps. No backwards compatibility is needed. A safe value is rendered immutable HTML. Design the internal provenance representation, not new source syntax.

representation.instructions: Choose the representation that satisfies the provenance and composition requirements with minimal mutable exposure.

criteria.weak: Frozen empty tokens keyed in private WeakMaps; retain escaped rendering and immutable structural metadata privately; use membership checks before reads.
criteria.brand: Publicly readable frozen records containing a string brand and markup; validate the brand field at sinks.
criteria.reparse: Store ordinary HTML strings and reparse them with a separate HTML parser at every sink to infer safety.
